title: The rack and its servers
alt: A technician slides servers into an empty rack at the end of a row, slot by slot. Power drops to it from the busway overhead, and heat leaves the back of the rack into the hot aisle.
sources: SPEC rack: Vertiv VR3300 (North American brochure 06/25), 600 x 1200 x 2000 mm, 42U
drawn_generically: the servers (2U, 19 in wide, 1.0 m deep)
heat arrows (direction only, not a measured flow)
placeholders: power per rack [n] kW: to be filled from the register / cascade

steps.caption: A rack is a steel frame 2 m tall with 42 slots for servers.
A technician slides the servers in, one slot at a time.
Power runs overhead to the rack.
The servers turn that power into heat, which leaves out the back.
